❯ Write a 60-word poem about rain, no tools.

● Rain begins as a rumor on the roof,
  a soft arithmetic of falling things.
  Gutters learn their old songs again;
  streets turn to mirrors, holding borrowed light.
  The garden drinks without asking why.
  I stand at the window, counting nothing,
  letting the grey sky do my thinking,
  until the last drop leaves the leaf
  and silence arrives, rinsed and clean.
